_note:
Each fetch is individually .catch-guarded to [] inside Promise.all, so a single rejection does NOT trip the error branch — the page renders empty instead. The error div only shows if the outer .then→.catch fires (e.g. an exception thrown in the mapper). To force the .qpage-error state in isolate, drive _signals.error directly. Renders:
Couldn't load invoices: Network request failed
— no styling, no role=alert.
